about: The registry of Aurélien's apps (design system v1.9): the app switcher at the top of every side menu reads it, the Brain cockpit and the attention connector (tools/attention-mcp) too. One entry per app, in menu order. key = the platform key (Pages project, D1, R2 prefix); shell = the app's data-ds-app value; icon = a kit icon (icons/icons.json); attention = the app's GET /api/attention, null when it has none. Copy it next to the app's pages at each release (as shell.js); change it here only.
